facetwp_indexing_behaviour: Custom field sources containing _to_ are expanded so each referenced post ID can be indexed separately.
Facet display values are replaced with get_the_title() where a title exists.
Rows can be skipped through the lsx_to_facetwp_index_skip_row filter.
FacetWP default indexing is skipped after inserting expanded relationship rows.
destination_hierarchy_behaviour: For destination_to_tour and destination_to_accommodation, the indexer adds parent_id and depth values based on the referenced destination hierarchy.
Without continent filtering, top-level destinations are depth 0 and child regions are depth 1.
With engine_search_continent_filter enabled, countries become depth 1 and regions become depth 2.
continent_filtering_behaviour: When enable_search_continent_filter is enabled, continent terms are retrieved from the continent taxonomy and inserted as depth 0 rows for destination_to_tour and destination_to_accommodation.
Facet HTML can render checkboxes or fselect options with country/region CSS classes and depth-aware visibility.
